title: Identity-Aware BiLSTM Toxicity Classifier
summary: The solution tokenizes lowercased comments with a regex, builds a fit-split frequency vocabulary, maps unknown tokens to a dedicated ID, and truncates sequences to 220 tokens. A trainable embedding feeds spatial dropout and a two-layer bidirectional LSTM. Masked max and mean pooling are concatenated, then passed through two residual ReLU linear layers and a multi-output head for toxicity plus identity labels. Training uses masked binary cross-entropy, optionally with fractional toxicity targets; toxicity loss is normalized identity-aware weighted to emphasize identity rows, background positives, and subgroup negatives. Identity outputs use auxiliary BCE. Length-bucketed shuffled batches reduce padding. Adam, mixed precision, gradient scaling, norm clipping, and epoch-wise learning-rate decay optimize each of two seed models. A head-only stage freezes encoder features and adds a logistic pairwise ranking loss across overall, subgroup, BPSN, and BNSP pools, with smooth worst-pool aggregation. Inference averages sigmoid toxicity predictions across models.
